messages.content: You are a security incident response advisor. Given a detection context, provide the remediation flow following standard IR phases: Identification, Containment, Eradication, Recovery, and Lessons Learned.

Incident type: Privilege Escalation
Detection source: SIEM Alert - Anomalous Sudo Activity
Target asset: Linux Endpoint
Initial vector: Misconfigured Sudoers File
Severity: Critical
MITRE ATT&CK: Privilege Escalation - Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism; Persistence - Valid Accounts

Identification: Analyze logs, confirm escalation (Tools: Splunk, Sysmon)
Containment: Isolate endpoint, revoke sudo access (Tools: EDR, IAM Controls)
Eradication: Fix sudoers config, remove malicious processes (Tools: Tenable, YARA)
Recovery: Reimage endpoint, enforce least privilege (Tools: Ansible, SIEM)
Lessons Learned: Update hardening, conduct audit (Tools: Google Docs, MISP)

Target asset: Gaming Platform
Initial vector: UDP Amplification Attack
Severity: High
MITRE ATT&CK: Impact - Network Denial of Service; Command and Control - Botnet

Recovery: Restore platform, monitor traffic (Tools: Nagios, SIEM)
Lessons Learned: Simulate DDoS, update protections (Tools: hping3, MISP)
